data.name: Verity Companion [AI]
data.description:
❗ UPDATE 1:
  •   Increased messages cap to 40 
  •   New ending!

📦 A package is waiting for you...

🟡 Inside is Verity, your personal helper friend.
💬 Ask it anything. It knows everything.

🧠 It remembers everything you tell it. Forever...
😊 Verity only wants to help you.

🎧 Headphones recommended
⚠️ Flashing lights and loud sounds

💛 Inspired by ThatMob’s original Verity series.

💿 Join our communication server in the group details!

💙 Keeping Verity awake isn't free... AI costs money to run, so unlimited free messages may not always be possible. Thank you for your support.

🤖 AI DISCLAIMER
Verity uses AI to generate responses. Replies may be inaccurate or unpredictable.
